intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that scans your vault for notes containing incomplete tasks (- [ ]) and writes a dated list of links to a file.
motivation: This helps me maintain a system I trust to track action items. I am a fan of David Allen's Getting Things Done. He suggested never mixing action items with reference material.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of separating actionable items from reference material within a knowledge base.
summary: A tool that scans the vault for notes containing unchecked tasks and generates a dated Markdown file listing links to those notes.
